name: Paraxial Ray Tracing
definition: A method to trace rays in the vicinity of a central ray by computing first-order perturbations $\delta \mathbf{x}$ and $\delta \mathbf{p}$, allowing for the estimation of caustics and light transport.
summary: Paraxial ray tracing estimates light transport by computing first-order perturbations around a central ray, distinguishing itself by maintaining a bundle of nearby rays to efficiently render refractive caustics in heterogeneous media.
